audit_items.proof_trace: Both ADL entry points (`liquidate_adl_borrow` L224, `liquidate_adl_deposit` L273) pass `whitelist_admin::adl()` = 3 (bit 3) to `pre_liquidation_check`, while normal liquidation passes `whitelist_admin::liquidation()` = 2 (bit 2). `ensure_has_permission` checks these as independent bitmask bits: a cap with only liquidation permission (mask 0x4) fails the ADL check (mask 0x8), aborting with `caller_has_no_permission`. The internal ADL market functions are `public(package)`, so no bypass path exists.
